plan.title: Scholarship Application Overview
plan.subtitle: Summary of applicant demographics, financial eligibility, and processing status

panels.title: Average Family Income
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Family Income") AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants"

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Distribution by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top Schemes by Volume
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: District-wise Summary
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS total_applicants, AVG("Marks %") AS avg_marks, AVG("Family Income") AS avg_income FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

plan.narrative:
This report summarizes the current state of scholarship applications received by the board. A total of {{p1}} applicants have been processed, with an average academic performance of {{p2}}% across the cohort. The average family income reported is {{p3}}, which serves as a key metric for means-tested eligibility.

The processing pipeline shows a varied distribution of statuses, with the majority of applications currently in specific stages as detailed in the status breakdown. Demographically, the applications are spread across various social categories, reflecting the board's reach into different community segments.

Regarding the specific programs, the data highlights which schemes are most popular among applicants. The district-wise summary provides a granular view of regional participation, allowing the board to identify high-volume areas and correlate them with average academic scores and income levels.
